build_identity.desktop: Windows interactive RDP session (xfreerdp3 client), 1600x1000, 96 DPI unless stated

actions: Tab x13 / Shift+Tab; empty required + Enter; type + Enter; drag-select, Ctrl+X/Z/Shift+Z; wheel over table; right-click
expected: Keyboard navigation, pointer, selection, scroll, default actions
observed: Tab order name, priority, notes, estimate, progress, notify, work, attachment, add-row, theme, quit, second-window, choose-file, show-dialog; invalid empty required blocks submit; Enter submits; drag selection 'alpha be', cut/undo/redo exact; wheel scrolls table (648->576) and back
limitations: Right/middle presses do not move focus (shared renderer rule, same on Linux)
